== Notes ==
* Sergeant Behnwa has an [[Elder Hyena]] for an [[animal companion]]. It cannot be [[Charm Animal|charmed]].
* The fastest way to reach him is from [[Sunspear Sanctuary]] (as part of a GoD run). Second from [[Venta Cemetery]] (storyline) and third from [[Gate of Desolation]]. His Kournan group stands near a bridge often used to cross the explorable area.
